source_name: Centrálny register zmlúv (CRZ) – contracts of Slovenská pošta and RÚ
why_relevant: Mandatory publication of state-entity contracts reveals payment/IT vendors, terminal and cash-handling suppliers and the Slovenská pošta–bank cooperation agreements — indirect disclosure of infrastructure spend not present in annual reports.

source_name: Slovenská banková asociácia (SBA) – payment-services projects and standards
why_relevant: The banking association coordinates SK scheme-level work (SEPA implementation, CGI standard, instant payments) with NBS and the State Treasury; its project pages are the best pointer to national scheme bodies and working groups.

source_name: NBS SEPA implementation plan and SEPA archive documents
why_relevant: Historical migration plan naming every SK actor (NBS, MF SR, Štátna pokladnica, banks, SBA) and the infrastructure milestones — a ready-made actor map for the national clearing ecosystem.

source_name: NBS history section – SIPS / TARGET2-SK / BZCS institutional record
why_relevant: Documents predecessor and successor infrastructure (BZCS a.s., later RVS a.s. in liquidation; TARGET2-SK to TARGET-SK) — needed to interpret long time series and to identify legacy operators still holding records.

source_name: ECB Data Portal / SDW – payments statistics, Slovakia country tables
why_relevant: Harmonised, API-accessible SK payment-volume data (credit transfers, direct debits, card payments, e-money) that lets national clearing figures be benchmarked against euro-area peers.

source_name: NBS aktuality / press releases (payments and payment systems)
why_relevant: First-publication channel for infrastructure changes (SIPS/TARGET-SK access opening, instant-payment deadlines, incidents); the earliest signal ahead of annual reports.

source_name: NBS payments hub (Platobný styk / Payments landing)
why_relevant: Top-level index that links every NBS payment-infrastructure subsection (systems, instruments, oversight, statistics, registers) — the single best snowballing entry point for this cell.

source_name: FinReg.sk – Slovenská pošta financial register profile
why_relevant: Secondary aggregator of Slovak financial-register data; useful cross-check on the postal operator's filings when the primary register or the PDF report lags.

source_name: SME / index.sme.sk and SITA – trade press on SK payment infrastructure
why_relevant: Slovak business press covers infrastructure launches, outages and postal-bank contract news that institutions disclose only tersely; useful for dating events and for names of vendors/officials.

source_name: NBS – Subjekty finančného trhu (financial market entities database + bulk download/API)
why_relevant: Machine-readable master database of all NBS-supervised entities incl. payment institutions, e-money institutions, CASPs and passporting foreign firms. NBS announced bulk download support, making it the backbone actor map for the cell.

source_name: NBS – Dohľad nad kryptoaktívami / MiCA licensing section
why_relevant: Authoritative source on MiCA-licensed crypto-asset service providers in SK (NBS reported six licensed CASPs) and on licence grants/refusals — a leading indicator of which crypto actors survive regulation.

source_name: Transparex – company economic/legal analysis (SK)
why_relevant: Alternative SK company-intelligence aggregator; useful as a cross-check/fallback to FinStat for ownership and financial profiles of fintech entities.

source_name: FinReport.sk – FinTech section
why_relevant: The most consistent SK-language trade outlet covering fintech market entries, licences and payment-provider news (e.g. kevin. entering SK, Fintech Hub launches, PSD2 uptake by SK firms). Strong pointer to actors and to primary press releases.

source_name: Startitup.sk – startups section
why_relevant: High-volume SK startup coverage incl. Startup Awards results; surfaces very early-stage payments/fintech actors that no register or trade press has yet named.

source_name: Innovate Slovakia / SAPIE ecosystem database (Dealroom-powered)
why_relevant: SAPIE built the first structured SK innovation-ecosystem database with Dealroom.co, reported to hold ~372 startups and ~250 funding rounds — an off-the-shelf actor map and round log filterable to fintech/payments.

source_name: Startup Report Slovensko (Slovenská sporiteľňa / Civitta / SASK)
why_relevant: Annual survey-based mapping of the SK startup ecosystem incl. funding conditions; gives denominator context and named cohorts for fintech actors. Published by a bank (SLSP) + Civitta + Startup Awards.

source_name: Slovenská sporiteľňa Seed Starter (corporate VC programme)
why_relevant: First SK bank corporate VC/startup financing programme; its portfolio and cohort announcements reveal which fintech/payments startups a major bank is betting on — an early partnership signal.

source_name: Fumbi (SK crypto-asset investment provider) newsroom
why_relevant: Flagship SK crypto-asset actor, among the first to obtain NBS MiCA authorisation; its own newsroom/blog announces AUM, product launches and licence milestones ahead of statutory filings.

source_name: Vacuumlabs (SK fintech/blockchain software builder)
why_relevant: Largest SK fintech engineering firm and Fintech Hub co-founder; its client case studies, blog and leadership interviews reveal which banks/neobanks/payment products are being built in and for SK before public launch.

source_name: Revolut Bank – SK market newsroom / Revolut press
why_relevant: Largest foreign neobank in SK, operating on an EU banking licence with local-branch migration of Slovak customers. Its press releases disclose SK customer numbers and product rollouts not visible in SK registers.

source_name: kevin. (A2A / open-banking payments, active in SK)
why_relevant: Lithuania-based A2A/open-banking payments provider that entered the SK market and positions against Visa/Mastercard; a bellwether for PSD2-based payment acceptance in SK retail.

source_name: Prima banka / ČSOB PSD2 TPP pages (bank-side open-banking directories)
why_relevant: Banks publish which third-party providers connect to their PSD2 APIs and the developer-portal terms — an indirect reveal of which fintechs are actually live on SK bank rails, not merely licensed.

source_name: EU-Startups / The Recursive – CEE startup funding trackers (Slovakia coverage)
why_relevant: English-language regional trackers publishing SK-specific round-ups (promising SK startups, biggest SK funding rounds H1 2026); catch cross-border rounds that SK media miss.

source_name: Tracxn – FinTech startups in Slovakia
why_relevant: Commercial startup database with an SK fintech segment view (reported ~167 active SK fintech companies, ~USD 37.2m raised) — quick sizing and a ranked actor list for cell coverage checks.

source_name: CEE Fintech Atlas – Slovak fintech ecosystem profile
why_relevant: Regional mapping initiative with a dedicated SK ecosystem write-up; useful for baseline structure and for names of older SK fintech actors, though the entry is dated.

source_name: SBA — Members list (Zoznam členov / Members)
why_relevant: Enumerates the full universe of SK banks and associate members — 20 full members (365.bank, ČSOB, Slovenská sporiteľňa, Tatra banka, VÚB, Prima banka, mBank, J&T, Komerční banka, UniCredit CZ&SK, Oberbank, BKS, Citibank, ING, PKO BP, Penta Bank, Cofidis, PSS, Wüstenrot, SZRB) plus associates (Centrálny depozitár cenných papierov SR, Eximbanka, Regional Card Processing Centre, Nexi Group). Each member entry links to the member's own site → seeds A1 IR/disclosure sources. Presence of RCPC and Nexi flags card-processing vendors in-market.

source_name: Národná banka Slovenska — Profesijné združenia (professional associations directory)
why_relevant: Regulator-curated master list of SK financial-sector self-regulatory bodies with URLs: SBA (+Inštitút ARS), SLASPO, ADDS, ADSS, AFISP, AOCP, APSÚ, Rada pre reklamu, SASS. Highest-authority pointer for this coverage cell — defines the association landscape without guesswork.

source_name: Asociácia leasingových spoločností SR (ALS SR)
why_relevant: Leasing association covering ~90% of the SK leasing market; member of Leaseurope. Publishes monthly market indicator statistics for Slovakia and European comparatives — rare sector-level quantitative disclosure for non-bank finance. Also documents (stanovy, etický kódex), press releases and a vehicle register.
